verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 at https://loops.so/openapi.json with an "openapi" key, which shows a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. The documented REST API reference (endpoints like POST /events/send and POST /contacts/create) is what the spec would describe. Missing for 10: first-party docs that advertise or link the OpenAPI spec download, and evidence of the spec's completeness or version currency against the full API.
